---
name: Security vulnerability (redirects to private reporting)
about: Do not describe vulnerabilities in public issues
title: "security: please use private reporting"
labels: [security]
---

**Please do not put any vulnerability details in this public issue.**

Report it privately through **Security → Report a vulnerability** (a private GitHub security advisory) on
this repository, as described in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md). Maintainers will close any public issue
that contains vulnerability details and move the report into a private advisory.

If you only need to ask *how* to report something, you may write that question here — without details.
